login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.description: For eRecycleHub staff only. Customer and seller accounts sign in on the main site.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.pendingApplications: {count, plural, =0 {No seller applications waiting} one {# seller application waiting} other {# seller applications waiting}}
dashboard.pendingTopUps: {count, plural, =0 {No top-up requests waiting} one {# top-up request waiting ({amount})} other {# top-up requests waiting ({amount})}}
dashboard.unreadMessages: {count, plural, =0 {No unread messages} one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
dashboard.bidsCompare: {last, plural, one {# bid} other {# bids}} last month
dashboard.chartSummary: {total, plural, one {# bid} other {# bids}} in the last 30 days; busiest day {day} with {max}.
dashboard.chartNone: No bids in the last 30 days.

reports.title: Auctions report
reports.description: Auctions by end date and country, with the winning bidder for ended auctions.
reports.empty: No auctions end in this range.

winners.title: Auction winners
winners.description: The highest bidder of each ended auction. Each winner is emailed once.
winners.notifyAllTitle: Email every winner who hasn't been notified?
winners.notifyAllBody: Each un-notified winner of an ended auction receives one congratulation email and an in-app notification.
winners.empty: No ended auctions with bids in this range.

users.title: Customers
users.name: Name
users.featuredHint: Shown on the public “Our clients” page (needs a picture).
users.deactivated: Account deactivated. Their sessions were ended.
users.openingCreditHint: Optional. Recorded as an approved credit in the ledger.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password. Setting one signs the user out everywhere.
users.walletReadOnly: The wallet only changes through transactions.

publishers.title: Publishers
publishers.deleteBody: Only publishers without auctions or wallet history can be deleted. Otherwise, deactivate them.

applications.title: Seller applications
applications.description: Companies asking for a seller account. Approving creates a publisher account with the password the applicant chose.
applications.approveBody: A publisher account is created for {email} and they are emailed.
applications.rejectBody: The applicant is told by email that the application wasn't approved.
applications.tempTitle: The approval email could not be sent
applications.tempBody: Give this one-time password to the applicant securely. It is shown only now.

transactions.title: Wallet transactions
transactions.description: Top-up requests from customers and credits added by administrators. Approving credits the wallet exactly once.
transactions.approveBody: The wallet is credited with this amount once. This is recorded in the ledger and the audit log.
transactions.rejectBody: Nothing is credited. The customer is notified.
transactions.reverseBody: The amount is debited from the wallet. If it was already used, the balance can go below zero.
transactions.deleteBody: Only pending or rejected requests can be deleted; they never changed the balance.
transactions.newDescription: Credits an account immediately (approved). Use it for bank transfers you have already received.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Sensitive actions: money, accounts, auctions and content changes.
